HOW YOUR SELECTION WORKS

Two choices.
One visible calculation.

The station group determines the rate. Your chosen amount determines the dollar illustration. Increasing the amount does not change the group's rate.

You can inspect both before saving a plan. No real payment is collected.

Understand the choices
before the numbers.

The public pages explain the proposed business, evidence and conditions. The calculator belongs to your workspace.

Does entering a larger amount change my rate?+

No. The selected station group sets the rate. Changing the amount recalculates the dollar illustration at that same rate.

Do the public locations establish an investment right?+

No. Location records and photographs are references. Company ownership, the legal instrument and client rights still need to be documented.

What happens when I open the account?+

You can enter an amount, compare the groups, select stations and review a sample weekly calculation. No real payment is taken.
